title: RNA Isolation for Tissue using TRIzol
author: Sze-Xian Lim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zvwf67e

steps.title: Add 1 mL, TRIzol of TRIzol...
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL, TRIzol of TRIzol per 30 mg, tissue of tissue and homogenize using handheld homogenizer.

steps.title: Incubate at 25 °C for 00:05:00...
steps.instruction: Incubate at 25 °C for 00:05:00 to allow nucleoprotein complexes to dissociate.

steps.title: Centrifuge at max speed for 00:15:00 at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at max speed for 00:15:00 at 4 °C .

steps.title: Carefully remove the top aqueous phase...
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the top aqueous phase and transfer to a new Eppendorf tube. The interphase and bottom organic phase can be saved for DNA and protein respectively.

steps.title: Add 500 µL, 100% isopropanol of...
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL, 100% isopropanol of 100% isopropanol to the aqueous phase, mix by inversion and incubate at -20 °C for a minimum of 02:00:00 .

steps.title: Spin down at maximum speed for...
steps.instruction: Spin down at maximum speed for 30 mins to precipitate RNA.

steps.title: Remove supernatant, and add 1 mL...
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, and add 1 mL of 75 % volume, ethanol ethanol to wash pellet.

steps.title: Add 200 µL, chloroform of chloroform...
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL, chloroform of chloroform to each ml of TRIzol carefully and vortex to mix well.

steps.title: Spin down at max speed for...
steps.instruction: Spin down at max speed for 15 minutes and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in appropriate volume of nuclease free water
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in appropriate volume of nuclease free water.
